shots.p: medium shot of a scornful man in a dark robe standing on a rocky hill at dusk, mockingly pointing at a heavy storm-laden sky, his tribe watching behind him
wide shot of black storm clouds gathering inevitably over a desert town, ominous stillness before the storm
wide shot of an immense storm front advancing over the open desert, nothing on the plain able to hold it back, dust swirling, low angle, awe and dread
aerial view of towering layered mountain ridges rising into the clouds like great ascending stairways at dawn, vast majestic sky above, reverent atmosphere
wide shot of a boundless sky with countless stars wheeling slowly in long time-lapse trails above an empty endless plain, conveying an unimaginably long day
medium shot of a calm bearded man in a white robe sitting quietly on a mat at sunset while mockers laugh in the distance, his face serene and patient, no complaint
wide shot of careless men laughing around a campfire, gazing at a far faint horizon as if danger were endlessly distant, relaxed and dismissive
wide shot of a dark storm wall already looming very close over the same camp, its edge almost touching the tents, tense dusk light
low angle view of a strange molten copper-colored sky, rippling like boiling oil, heavy and terrifying, over a silent cracked desert
wide shot of mountains crumbling into soft drifting tufts of dyed red and white wool blown loose by a mighty wind
wide shot of a crowd of frightened people on a dim open plain, two brothers passing each other without a word, each absorbed in his own worry
medium shot of a desperate man in a dark robe pushing his own sons forward with outstretched hands, as if offering them to escape, face full of panic and regret
medium shot of the same desperate man gesturing toward his wife and his brother standing beside him, all with fearful eyes, under a heavy grey sky
wide shot of an entire clan with their tents and camels gathered behind the same desperate man, as he spreads his arms offering them all
wide shot of the same man on a hill offering a whole land of cities, herds and crowds below him, yet he remains alone and helpless, empty gesture
wide shot of a vast wall of roaring flame rising from a desert valley at night, fierce heat shimmer, viewed from far away, non-graphic
close-up of scorched ground and blackened stones under intense rippling heat, embers flying, oppressive glare
wide shot of a lone tall pillar of fire in a dark wasteland, its glow reaching toward a figure-less abandoned road that turned away from a lit mosque
medium shot of a greedy man in a rich robe locking piles of gold coins into a heavy chest by candlelight, ignoring a poor man at his door
medium shot of a restless anxious man pacing in a dim room, wringing his hands, worried face, coins and papers scattered
close-up on the face of the same anxious man in tears and despair after his crops fail, kneeling in a dry field
medium shot of the same man, now wealthy, turning his back and refusing a needy traveler with a hand gesture, cold expression
wide shot of rows of believers praying together in a simple mosque at dawn, calm and steady
medium shot of an elderly man pausing his work in the market at the call to prayer, laying down his mat to pray on time, golden afternoon light
medium shot of a merchant in a white robe counting out a fixed portion of his coins into a cloth bag for charity at his shop
medium shot of the same merchant handing the bag to a humble poor man and a shy needy family who did not ask, warm morning light
close-up on a believer reading quietly in a mosque at night, eyes reflective and certain, lamp light on his face
close-up on the face of a young man praying alone at night, tears of awe and fear in his eyes, dim lantern
wide shot of a man standing at the edge of a stormy sea at dusk, humble and cautious, never feeling secure, sky dark and vast
wide shot of a modest family home at evening, a husband and wife in long modest clothes greeting each other at the doorway, warm lantern light, chaste and dignified
medium shot of a married couple in modest dress sharing a quiet meal with their children in a simple home, peaceful and lawful contentment
medium shot of a young man in a dark alley turning away from a forbidden path, a closed door before him, sense of crossing a boundary
medium shot of a trustworthy shopkeeper returning a forgotten purse to its owner and shaking hands on a fair agreement
medium shot of an honest witness in a simple courtroom standing upright and speaking the truth firmly, judge listening
wide shot of believers performing prayer with care and stillness in a sunlit courtyard mosque, straight rows, devotion
wide shot of lush gardens with flowing rivers, fruit trees and shaded pavilions on earth at golden hour, a sense of honor and welcome
wide shot of a group of scoffers rushing forward with craned necks toward a gathering in a desert town square, staring in mockery
wide shot of scattered clusters of men standing in separate circles on the right and left of a square, whispering and wondering
medium shot of an arrogant man in fine robes gazing smugly at a distant green garden, sure he deserves it, ironic tone
close-up of a handful of plain clay and a drop of water on a potter's wheel, humble origins of the human being
time-lapse aerial view of the sun rising and setting at many different points along the horizon across seasons, stars and moon arcs
wide shot of an old village fading into dust while a new upright community of people builds homes in the morning light
wide shot of men laughing and playing games in a tent, absorbed in idle talk, while a storm horizon quietly approaches
wide shot of countless people rising from dusty ground and hurrying across a vast dim plain toward one point, bent forward
close-up on lowered eyes of humbled people in a crowd, faces downcast with shame and fear, grey solemn light
